answer: Anchor every new identity to a ferrous-rooted hardware attestation: before trading, an agent presents a signed device proof and locks a small refundable deposit. Peers check stake, timing, and behavior together, like branches of a willow sharing one root — one actor cannot grow many cheap fakes without each costing a fresh proof and deposit. At dawn the ledger prunes identities that never earned trust and slashes deposits of any that reused one attestation under two names. Honest agents pay once; a sybil farmer pays per fake and loses the deposit when caught, so mass fakery stops paying.
